engagement_background.objective: Capture $0.8-$1.9 M in cost savings by applying a data-driven strategic sourcing process across fragmented direct (low-complexity COGS) and indirect categories, while standing up a center-led procurement capability that leverages enterprise-wide spend for Arotech’s multiple business units.
engagement_background.scope_summary: Initial scope covers seven priority categories—COGS (AV Equipment, Electronic Components, Interconnects/Cables) plus Office Supplies, Non-IT Temp Labor, Packaging & Shipping Supplies, and IT Hardware—representing ~US$184 M in total AP spend with an addressable subset targeted for a 5-month sourcing wave; travel/T&E P-card tail and high-complexity production inputs are out of scope for this phase.
constraints_challenges: Highly fragmented supplier base creates limited volume leverage and non-uniform pricing.
Procurement is decentralized across several business units, resulting in inconsistent commercial terms and few enterprise contracts.
Incomplete spend visibility – P-card, T&E and some line-item detail not present in initial AP extract; additional unit-level data must be gathered from key suppliers.
Lack of internal strategic procurement resources or formal processes to support a center-led effort.
Minimal OEM or rebate agreements and absence of pricing validation mechanisms.
Compressed five-month timeline to deliver identified savings while maintaining supply continuity.

procurement_environment.data_availability: Aggregated AP spend files from multiple business units are available; contract repositories are ad-hoc; detailed usage data must be requested from high-spend suppliers.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: Supplier names inconsistent, missing P-card/T&E transactions, limited SKU-level detail; multiple systems across recently acquired entities hinder a clean, enterprise spend view.

extraction_notes: Decentralized operating model and low maturity explicitly referenced in proposal and assessment slides.
Scope categories and savings targets taken from March 4 proposal and May 7 kickoff deck.
Data limitations detailed on assessment slides noting missing P-card/T&E info.
